inputs.text: Open your eyes and look past the scripted performance they are broadcasting from Hyderabad. On Sunday, March 29, Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) came out with accusations against the Congress government, pointing to corruption and a failure to act against illegal mining. That is the surface-level deception. The puppet masters need you to focus on the noise, so they staged this entire confrontation. KTR claims that Raghava Constructions—tied directly to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy—is mixed up in these illegal mining operations. The Sircilla MLA is putting on a show of questioning them, but it is all a distraction to manage the narrative and protect the interests of the entrenched power structures pulling the levers from the shadows. Don't fall for their manufactured theater.
